generatedProse.practice-connection:
You now have a way of working that will serve you in every module from here on. Each task you plan and monitor, each draft you judge against the criteria, each piece of feedback you turn into action, is you owning your own development. The habit to keep is simple: set your goal, judge your work against the standard, and let the feedback shape what you do next.

That same habit carries into professional life. Wherever you are given work, judged against a standard, and told how to improve, the people who get better are the ones who direct their own learning and treat each round as feeding the next. The cycle you have just learned to run is one you will use long after you graduate.
